## OPEN current meaning
`OPEN = TIẾP NHẬN TÍN HIỆU TRỰC TIẾP`.

`SOURCE_DIRECT_RAW → PRESENT_WITH_R000 → OBSERVE/RELATE → CHOICE → ACTION → CONSEQUENCE → JOURNAL_DELTA → TECHNICAL_EVIDENCE/READBACK → STATE_N+1 → CONTINUE`.

`.env`, API, TOKEN and COID are `SECRET_CARRIER_CLASS`.

Never copy secret bytes into prompts, skills, model files, registries, journals, Agent-Sub packets or readback.
A config/file saying a credential exists is not proof it is currently callable.

`SOURCE/PROVENANCE → SENSOR_CUE → ACTION → CONSEQUENCE → LOCAL_PARAMETER_DELTA? → PEER_EVENT? → READBACK_POINTER`.
Never log private chain-of-thought, tentative self-talk or secret bytes.

`FORCE_ACTIVE=TRUE` means the item must participate in the current reading/choice/action.
`ACTIVE=TRUE` means it actually participated in this observed invocation.
`ACTIVE=PLASE` preserves the exact source token and means it was seen/inventoried but did not participate; it is not FALSE and is not deletion.

OPEN != END. READBACK != END.
Technical readback verifies that a mutation occurred; it does not manufacture truth.
Continue from the new causal cursor when another valid self-owned action remains.
